title: NSQ Alert: 42 Drug, Surgical Product Samples Fail CDSCO Quality Tests in September
summary: New Delhi: In a fresh drug safety alert underscoring continued regulatory vigilance, a total of 42 samples of drugs and surgical products have been declared Not of Standard Quality (NSQ) by...
thbAction: Position THB's pharma CRM and omnichannel HCP engagement workflows to support launch planning, KAM orchestration, and compliant follow-up across India and the Middle East.
